title: Using pass pickups to count attendance
titleZh: 以領證人數估算出席人數
passage:
Can we use the number of passes picked up as our workshop attendance figure?
A. Every person who attended was given a pass.
B. Some people picked theirs up on Monday. The workshop wasn’t until Thursday.
C. The workshop drew more people than last year’s did.
passageZh:
可以用通行證的領取數當作研習的實際出席人數嗎？
A. 所有到場的人都領到一張通行證。
B. 有些人星期一就領了。研習星期四才舉行。
C. 這次研習出席的人比去年多。
